name: hornero
description: Role-and-skill methodology for Codex CLI: 7 reviewer subagents, ~60 expert-grounded skills across software-engineer, product-manager, designer, tester, security-expert, marketing-expert, and data-scientist roles, plus a dispatcher protocol that routes prompts to the right role-skill pair. Vendor-agnostic — paired sibling of .claude-plugin/plugin.json for Claude Code.
